# ADR 0002: FFI boundary

## Status
Accepted.

## Context
Flutter/Swift/Kotlin (now Swift/Kotlin per plan) must call the agent runtime
offline through a stable native interface.

## Decision
* Use **UniFFI 0.28.3** to expose `agent-sdk` as a `cdylib` (`libagent_sdk`).
* The FFI surface is intentionally tiny and stable: `SdkAgent` (`run`,
  `session`), `SdkSession` (`memorize`, `recall`), `create_agent`, plus the
  `SdkAgentConfig` record and `SdkError`.
* Bindings are generated by `crates/agent-ffigen` (`just ffi`), pinned to the
  same UniFFI version as the runtime, producing `bindings/swift` and
  `bindings/kotlin`.
* Any change to the FFI surface MUST be followed by regenerating the bindings
  and is checked in CI (the `ffi` job fails if generation errors or the
  committed bindings drift).

## Consequences
* Adding/renaming exported items changes the ABI; consumers must regenerate.
* The `openai` feature on `agent-sdk` enables real OpenAI calls in the native
  runtime; without it, `StubModel` is used.
